"""
Type definitions for Safety Mechanisms and Fallback
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from enum import Enum
from typing import Dict, List, Optional

class SafetyLevel(Enum):
    """安全レベル"""

    LOW = "low"
    MEDIUM = "medium"
    HIGH = "high"
    CRITICAL = "critical"
    WARNING = "warning"
